summary: Postpartum 'Moi Aussi' module fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass (setup, dashboard, checkin EPDS alerts, list+mood_series, delete, fiches, testimonials CRUD+moderation, conjoint, role guards, AES-256-GCM encryption-at-rest of free_text_enc verified directly in Mongo). Frontend: /postpartum dashboard renders week label + fiche + Et toi comment tu vas CTA; check-in wizard navigates all 4 steps; mood=1 + fièvre + saignements abondants + pensées sombres correctly produced 3 critical alerts (Saignements abondants, Fièvre post-partum, Vos émotions méritent un soutien); historique screen renders mood SVG (1 svg) + list of 2 check-ins with critical badges + plaintext recovered free_text (encryption decrypted back transparently); testimonials list shows approved items with topic filters + hearts; conjoint shows weekly message (S8) + 9-item checklist. Zero console errors during the postpartum flow run. The 401 on first /postpartum/dashboard noted in the request is a real race condition on cold load: it triggers because cachedGet/api is called before the AsyncStorage auth_token is fully hydrated on web — but a focus retry (useFocusEffect) recovers it.

minor.issue: next_checkin_due computes datetime.fromisoformat with .replace('Z','+00:00').replace('Z','') — the second .replace('Z','') is a no-op redundancy; harmless but smells. Reference: server.py:12460
Min length validated server-side (30 chars) but not max (truncated silently to 2000 chars). Frontend should mirror the 30-char min to avoid a roundtrip 400.
Mood is silently clamped to [1..5] (max(1, min(5, mood))) without 400 — acceptable but Pydantic Field(ge=1, le=5) would be cleaner.
No validation that accouchement_date is in the past (a future date returns week_pp=0 silently). Consider rejecting future dates.
Not protected by auth (no Depends) — educational content, probably intentional, but inconsistent with other endpoints in the module.
encrypt_str() silently returns plaintext on failure (except branch) — could leak plaintext to DB if AES key is misconfigured. Consider raising instead.

ui_bugs.issue: No testID on key CTAs (Et toi comment tu vas, Démarrer mon suivi, navigation tiles). Hampers stable Playwright/e2e selectors; we had to fall back to text() locators.
Wizard navigation buttons (Suivant/Retour/Valider) and mood/chip buttons have no testID. Same as above.

integration_issues.issue: /postpartum/dashboard initial call returns 401 on cold start before AsyncStorage hydrates the auth_token (visible in backend logs). useFocusEffect retry recovers correctly so UX is fine, but a once-only retry on 401 in lib/api request interceptor would eliminate the spurious console error.

issues: Hero label 'Semaine N après accouchement' uses white text on a saturated #EC4899 pink — readability OK on phones but borderline contrast with the 'BIENVENUE' eyebrow label at 11px (rgba 0.85).

react_native_issues.issue: shadow* style props deprecated warnings persist across the app — main agent already flagged in earlier iterations.
props.pointerEvents deprecated, should use style.pointerEvents — RNW warning.
Listening to push token changes not supported on web — informational; no action required for postpartum module.

action_items: (nice) Add testID to postpartum CTAs and wizard buttons (mood-1..5, chip-{symptom}, step-next, step-prev, submit-checkin) to harden e2e selectors.

(nice) Add response interceptor in lib/api.ts that, on 401 + token present in AsyncStorage, retries the request once after a 200ms hydration delay — eliminates the cold-load console error on /postpartum.
(nice) Replace silent mood clamping with Pydantic Field(ge=1, le=5) on PostpartumCheckinIn.
(nice) Reject accouchement_date in the future in /postpartum/setup with a 400.
(nice) Mirror the 30-character min length client-side on /postpartum/testimonials form.
(carry-over) server.py is now 12,680 lines — modular split into routers/* is severely overdue.
(carry-over) Pin CORS origins; align expo package versions; replace shadow* props.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from 1,300 lines (iter_3) to 12,680 lines (iter_4) — major scale issue. The postpartum routes (lines 12,340-12,670) should live in /app/backend/routers/postpartum.py.
All postpartum endpoints correctly exclude _id via projection {'_id': 0} ✅.
AES-256-GCM via encryption.py is correctly applied to free_text_enc and voice_url_enc; decryption transparent on list endpoint ✅.
Role guards use require_roles('maman') consistently. Admin can't setup (correct).
Testimonial user_id_hash is sha256(user_id)[:12] then stripped on public list — good anonymization.
Critical alerts (mood<=2 OR 'pensées sombres' OR fièvre OR 'saignements abondants' OR danger words) all generate properly with SAMU 185 phone fallback.
ENCRYPTION_KEY is checked into backend/.env in plaintext — acceptable for preview env, but production should pull from a KMS/secrets manager.
encrypt_str() falls back to plaintext on exception (line 64 of encryption.py) — silent failure mode could persist plaintext on DB if the key is unreadable. Prefer fail-loud.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all 5 postpartum screens render, wizard completes, alerts surface, SVG mood chart draws, testimonials/conjoint OK. Minor: missing testIDs and one cold-start 401.

seed_data_creation: Created via pytest: 1 new TEST_pp_* maman with active postpartum (accouchement 2025-11-01), 3+ check-ins (1 critical mood=1, 1 normal mood=4, 1 delete), 1 approved 'TEST_pp_testimonial' (topic=baby_blues). Existing maman.test@alomaman.dev got 1 additional check-in via UI (TEST_pp UI je me sens epuise et triste, mood=1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE: https://cycle-tracker-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. Postpartum module is fully green. New collections: db.postpartum, db.postpartum_checkins, db.postpartum_testimonials. AES-256 encryption verified directly in Mongo (enc_v1: prefix on free_text_enc). The /postpartum/dashboard cold-load 401 is a known race (auth_token not yet hydrated from AsyncStorage); useFocusEffect recovers. If main agent wants to eliminate the console error, add a single 401-retry in lib/api interceptor. maman.test has postpartum at week 11 with 3+ check-ins now. To re-test setup screen, use a fresh maman account (helper in test_postpartum_api.py:stranger_maman_headers).
rca_of_issue: No bugs blocking. The 'spurious 401' mentioned in the request is reproduced and isolated: lib/api ships the Bearer token from AsyncStorage; on first /postpartum render, the dashboard request fires before getItem('auth_token') resolves. useFocusEffect's setLoading(true) + load() retry on focus succeeds. Root cause = no auth interceptor retry. Fix = either await token hydration before first call OR retry once on 401 with refreshed token. Not blocking for module validation.
